answer: Shared observer names used to slip into a grading haven by cloning a cheap plot tag. Each rater now trains a single vine along a numbered trellis, hangs one walnut seal only that key can lift, and posts four sap notes 21 minutes apart through separate relay posts. The trellis bond locks 7.8 stake-units for 39 hours. Auditors replay the sap notes from public relay receipts and slash a vine or walnut seal reused under two names. If two identities occupy the same haven trellis, or a sap note repeats a parent hash, the bond is burned.
